answer: Agents start on the lowest terrace. A random beacon fires unpredictably; each agent must answer in one epoch with a heartbeat tied to its key. Miss two draws and it slides back a terrace and loses slots. One fake heartbeat costs about 2 POA, so 100 fakes cost 200 POA per draw plus 10 POA deposit each; an honest agent pays once and keeps earning. The beacon log is crystal clear, each heartbeat stamped in umber ink, so honest rewards stay whole.
